about: Every mark of another company Mobster shows: the agents, assistants and AI providers it works with, the services it connects to, and the companies Network X-ray names, each used only to name the product or say whose servers they are (README.md). scripts/gen_agent_marks.py writes every surface's copy.

marks.name: Airtable
marks.note: Airtable's logo files are behind a shared Airtable view linked from its trademark guidelines (https://airtable.com/appiyS5IzOTBBj0el/shrxP0DqMdbLVY7fd/tblcRB6iqKxlYNrlV); that view is script-rendered and its attachment links could not be fetched without a browser, so no kit file was taken. Took the SVG favicon airtable.com serves itself (the icon, the three-shape mark). Only edit: removed the <style> block (path{fill:#000} with a prefers-color-scheme white override) and put fill="#000" on the three paths; geometry and the translate group are unchanged. Could be swapped for the kit's icon later.

marks.name: Amplitude
marks.note: The Amplitude symbol (the A with the wave), dark version (#231f20), linked from brand.amplitude.com (the Amplitude Brand Guide) and kept as published, with its inline style fill. The guide also serves the white version (framerusercontent.com/images/o7RJTD0r7u0FLxVhCucqflo1Egg.svg). The guide's public pages offer no kit zip and no written logo rules.

marks.name: Attio
marks.note: attio-logo-pack/svg/attio-logomark-dark.svg from the logo pack linked on attio.com/brand, unchanged (the black logomark; a white variant ships too). Same drawing as attio.com/brand/v1/attio-logomark.svg.

marks.name: Axiom
marks.note: axiom.co/brand and /press 404 and no kit is published (helloaxiom.ai/brand belongs to a different company). Took the symbol inline in axiom.co's own header/footer (viewBox 0 0 13 11, aria-label Axiom) on 2026-10-17. Only edits: dropped width/height/role/aria-label/class, and replaced fill="currentColor" with fill="#000". The path is unchanged.

marks.name: Basecamp
marks.note: the SVG favicon served by basecamp.com, unchanged (#29353c). basecamp.com/about/press now returns the home page and offers no files; the 37signals integration guidelines point to it for logos and say to contact them first.

marks.name: beehiiv
marks.note: No press or brand page (beehiiv.com/media-kit, /press, /brand are 404). Took the logo inline in beehiiv.com's own header (id=beehiiv-logo, viewBox 0 0 1396.92 308.78): one path holding the hive symbol followed by the wordmark letters. Cut out the wordmark by keeping only the first five sub-paths (the hive, up to the 'M558.67...' letter b), coordinates unchanged, viewBox tightened to 0 0 326 309; fill="#000" replaces the site's white fill class.

marks.name: Bitrise
marks.note: The press kit (https://bitrise.io/press/kit) is a Google Drive folder and its bitrise-icon.svg is white (#FFF) only. Taken instead the SVG favicon of bitrise.io (favicon_256x256.svg, Bitbot in brand purple #683D87, the site's own file) in its own colour, byte-for-byte. Press page colours: #6A3C98 #500E82 #DEB4FF #10C0C0 #95FFEC.

marks.name: Box
marks.note: box.com (kit, press page, trademark page) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge and the brand asset kit is a Box shared folder. Taken the Box developer docs' own app icon, developer.box.com/images/sidebar/box.svg, unchanged: white Box logo on its #0061D5 rounded square. The square was kept because the white logo has no colour of its own without it.

marks.name: Buildkite
marks.note: Mark file from the Buildkite brand-assets page, unchanged. Two greens (#14CC80, #30F2A2) that differ by tone; the green is about 2:1 on white, flagged below.

marks.name: Cal.com
marks.note: the 'Cal' icon from cal-logo-square-black.svg in the brand kit zip linked from cal.com/brand: the three white glyph paths, unchanged, the #242424 square dropped, viewBox tightened. The icon is the page's 'tight layouts or logo-only grids' mark and the favicon. The kit also ships a white-square and a black logo version.

marks.name: Calendly
marks.note: No downloadable kit or brand page found on calendly.com (calendly.com/press is a scheduling page, /brand and others 404). Taken the site's own SVG favicon, calendly.com/media/favicon/icon.svg, unchanged: white C on its blue gradient circle.

marks.name: Clerk
marks.note: symbol-primary.svg from clerk.com/brand-assets (the Download as SVG for the Symbol), unchanged. Two purples (#6C47FF, #BAB1FF). symbol-dark.svg and symbol-light.svg also exist but are one-colour.

marks.name: ClickHouse
marks.note: logomark-black.svg from the ClickHouse design site's logo page (linked from clickhouse.com/media as ClickHouse-Logomark-Black.svg); <style> class converted to fill="#161616", drawing unchanged. A white logomark exists for dark grounds.

marks.name: ClickUp
marks.note: Logomark-gradient.svg from clickup.com/brand (Symbol), unchanged. Same file as today; re-checked live on 2026-10-17, still the current v4 symbol.

marks.name: Close
marks.note: mark.svg from close-logo-2024.zip (linked from close.com/brand), unchanged. Re-checked: it is the current atom mark of the 2024 kit and the page still offers this kit.

marks.name: Cloudflare
marks.note: The press-kit zip (Logos.zip) holds only PNG and JPG. Took the official site's single-colour SVG logo and kept only its first two paths (the cloud), dropping the wordmark. Paths unchanged, fill white, so ink. The orange cloud icon is also in cloudflare.com/icons.svg (symbol 'cloudflare') if a coloured version is wanted.

marks.name: Coda
marks.note: Coda's own icon from its CDN, the mark coda.io serves as its icon, unchanged

marks.name: CodeRabbit
marks.note: Orange mark from coderabbit.ai/brand, unchanged (orange disc, white rabbit).

marks.name: Contentful
marks.note: contentful.com, press.contentful.com and the brand kit sit behind a Vercel bot checkpoint (HTTP 429 to curl and WebFetch), so the kit could not be downloaded. Took the five mark paths (blue, orange, yellow C) out of the Contentful 'from Salesforce' lockup SVG in Contentful's own forma-36 repo, dropped the wordmark and 'from Salesforce', tightened the viewBox. Paths unchanged. Re-check against press.contentful.com/media_kits when the kit loads.

marks.name: Crowdin
marks.note: Crowdin symbol kit file is an app-icon plate with the glyph on it. Took the cWhite file (white plate, #263238 glyph) and dropped only the plate path; the six glyph paths are unchanged. One colour #263238, so ink.

marks.name: Customer.io
marks.note: customer-io-logos/svg/logomark_spruce.svg, unchanged (spruce #0B363B is the on-light logomark; verdant and white versions exist for dark grounds). Previous verdant file replaced: verdant #ABFFAE is invisible on white. Mark is one colour, so ink.

marks.name: Datadog
marks.note: Logo_Assets.zip, DD Vector Logos/Icon/SVG/dd_icon_rgb.svg (Bits the dog, the official Datadog logo icon). Removed Illustrator metadata, converted the .st0 style class to fill/clip attributes (#632CA6), dropped Illustrator-only attributes. Drawing unchanged. Purple is weak on #1E1E1E and the kit ships a white icon, so ink.

marks.name: Discord
marks.note: Discord-Symbol-Blurple.svg from the Symbol (Color) download on discord.com/branding (the 'Clyde' logo symbol). Converted: the <style> class .cls-1{fill:#5865f2} became fill='#5865f2' on the path; XML prolog, <defs> and ids removed. Drawing unchanged. Kit also has black and white symbols.

marks.name: DuckDB
marks.note: DuckDB_icon-lightmode.svg from duckdb.org/design/duckdb.zip (the icon: yellow duck on a #1a1a1a disc); <style> classes converted to fill attributes, Illustrator comment and ids removed. The darkmode icon differs only by #1d1d1b for #1a1a1a, so no -dark file.

marks.name: Expo
marks.note: svg/logo-type-a.svg from github.com/expo/logos (the repo expo.dev/brand points to); file byte-for-byte, black #000. expo.dev's rendered header could not be compared (JS-drawn); the brand page still links this repo. Kit also has logo-type-b.

marks.name: Fireflies.ai
marks.note: the symbol (eight gradient paths, wordmark text dropped) from the inline logo-with-text SVG in fireflies.ai's header, unchanged. fireflies.ai/press is a 404 and no brand kit was found.

marks.name: GitHub
marks.note: GitHub_Invertocat_Black.svg from GitHub_Logos.zip (SVG/ folder; not the _Clearspace variant). File byte-for-byte. The kit also has GitHub_Invertocat_White.svg. Its glyph, for a button beside GitHub's name, is GitHub's own mark-github-24 octicon (https://github.com/primer/octicons, MIT), read 2026-10-17.

marks.name: GitLab
marks.note: gitlab-logo-500-rgb.svg from the press kit (the tanuki, 380x380, current). Converted: three CSS classes became fill attributes (#fca326, #fc6d26, #e24329); XML prolog, <defs>/<style>, ids removed. Drawing unchanged. The handbook logo rules (handbook.gitlab.com) redirect to a login, so not read.

marks.name: Google Drive
marks.note: Google's own 2026 Drive product icon (drive_2026, v2; replaces the 2020 icon Mobster has), linked from https://workspace.google.com/products/drive/. Only change: viewBox='0 0 192 192' added (file had width/height only). Google's branding page links a PNG of the same icon (https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/productlogos/drive_2026/v2/web-64dp/logo_drive_2026_color_2x_web_64dp.png).

marks.name: Google Sheets
marks.note: Google's own 2026 Sheets product icon vector (sheets_2026, v2; replaces the 2020 icon). File byte-for-byte. It holds a blur filter that the generator accepts; the preview matches Google's 512 px PNG (https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/productlogos/sheets_2026/v2/web-512dp/logo_sheets_2026_color_2x_web_512dp.png). Not taken from the Sheets branding page: Google publishes no Sheets-specific icon rules, so Drive's rules (google-drive row) are the nearest.

marks.name: Grafana
marks.note: No downloadable brand kit or guidelines page is published on grafana.com (/brand, /press, /about/press have none). Took public/img/grafana_icon.svg from Grafana Labs' own GitHub org (grafana/grafana): the orange-to-yellow gradient Grafana logo. Only edits: removed the XML prolog, Illustrator comment, empty group, enable-background/xml:space attributes, and converted the .st0 class to fill="url(#SVGID_1_)"; the path and gradient are unchanged. grafana.com itself now shows a flat #FF671D version of the same mark (storyblok grafana-logo-orange-40x40.svg); the gradient file is the logo as Grafana publishes it in its repo.

marks.name: Granola
marks.note: the spiral cut out of the inline header logo of granola.ai (first subpath of the one-path logo; #1E1E1E, wordmark dropped). The public press kit at grano.la/press is a Google Drive folder (Logos, Photos...) with no direct file link, so not taken. The site's favicon.svg is an embedded PNG, not vector.

marks.name: Help Scout
marks.note: Mark/Default/HelpScout-Mark-OnLight.svg (Cobalt #304DDB) from HelpScout-Logos.zip, unchanged; dark: Mark/Secondary/HelpScout-Mark-OnDark.svg (#4176FA). The kit also has one-colour versions (#131B24 and white).

marks.name: Honeycomb
marks.note: No brand kit or press page is published (honeycomb.io/brand and /press are 404). Took the logo inline in honeycomb.io's own page (title=Honeycomb, href=/) on 2026-10-17: the four coloured hexagons (#FFB000, #64BA00, #F96E10, #0298EC) are the last four paths of the logo svg; cut out the wordmark paths (#25303E) and kept the four hexagon paths unchanged, viewBox 0 0 51 48.

marks.name: Intercom
marks.note: No brand kit or press kit is published (intercom.com/press redirects to the home page; /brand, /press-kit, /brand-assets 404). Took the symbol inline in intercom.com's own header (the 36x37 viewBox svg shown on mobile; the 620x102 wordmark beside it was not used) on 2026-10-17: the Intercom chat-bars-and-smile mark as a one-colour rounded square with the bars and smile cut out. Only edits: dropped the class attribute and replaced fill="currentColor" with fill="#000" (the header draws it in ink).

marks.name: Jira
marks.note: jira/SVG/Jira_icon.svg from Atlassian's jira_app.zip (current logo after the 2025 rebrand: blue #1868DB square with white glyph). Kept whole: in Atlassian's current Jira logo the square is part of the mark (the lockups Jira_logo_light/dark draw it the same way), and a white glyph alone is invisible on a light tile. Not an ink mark; no separate dark version is offered.

marks.name: Jotform
marks.note: jotform-icon-transparent.svg from the Brand Assets page (icons section), unchanged: four brand-coloured bars (#0099FF, #FF6100, #FFB629, #0A1551). Same drawing as favicon-2021.svg without its white square.

marks.name: Klaviyo
marks.note: klaviyo.com/press is a 404 and klaviyo.com/brand redirects in a loop. Klaviyo's brand guidelines sit on a Brandpad page for employees and partners (brandpad.io/klaviyo-guidelines returns 404 and is described as confidential), so no kit file was taken. Took the flag symbol inline in klaviyo.com's own header (viewBox 0 0 266 178, path 'M266 178H0V0h266l-55.835 89z') on 2026-10-17, with fill="#000" in place of currentColor and the class/style attributes dropped.

marks.name: LaunchDarkly
marks.note: launchdarkly.com has no brand or press page (/brand and /press return 404). The symbol is the site's own footer logo (inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 39 39, 'LaunchDarkly Home' link), copied unchanged. It is white as served, so it must be drawn in the page's ink.

marks.name: Linear
marks.note: logo-dark.svg from Linear-Brand-Assets.zip: the 'Linear logo' logomark (not linear-icon.svg, the app icon square). It is the dark (#222326) version, for light grounds; logo-light.svg is the same drawing in #fff. File byte-for-byte.

marks.name: Lokalise
marks.note: Lokalise_Media_Kit.zip (linked from lokalise.com), Logomark/SVG/Lokalise_pink_logomark.svg. The kit's logomark is the three-bar symbol on a pink rounded square; the square is dropped and the symbol (clip group, fill #131E29) kept unchanged with the viewBox cropped to the symbol. The kit's Logo SVGs show the same symbol beside the wordmark in #1D1D1B (black) or white. One colour, so ink.

marks.name: Model Context Protocol
products: an MCP server of your own
marks.note: raw/mcp/light.svg and dark.svg verified: byte-identical to the logo served by modelcontextprotocol.io (header logo, mintcdn.com/mcp/.../logo/dark.svg); the GitHub repo docs/favicon.svg draws the same three strokes in white on a black rounded square. Both are the lockup (symbol + 'Model Context Protocol' wordmark). Cut the wordmark: kept the first three stroke paths of light.svg (black strokes) unchanged; viewBox set to 195x195. No brand kit or brand page exists (modelcontextprotocol.io/brand is 404).

marks.name: Mercury
marks.note: icon.svg served by mercury.com (the ornament, #272735), unchanged except the <style> dark-mode rule (#f4f5f9) and the id attribute removed. mercury.com/brand, /press and /media-kit are 404; no press kit found.

marks.name: Metricool
marks.note: No brand kit or press kit is published (metricool.com/press is a blog post list; /brand and /media-kit are blog pages). Took the SVG Metricool serves itself on static.metricool.com: the infinity-loop symbol, which matches the dark mark on the lime app icon at metricool.com's favicon (checked 2026-10-17). Only edits: removed the XML prolog, DOCTYPE, the <style> block (dark grey rgb(61,61,61), white in dark mode) and width/height 100%; moved the style attributes to fill/fill-rule attributes with fill="rgb(61,61,61)". Path and transform unchanged.

marks.name: Miro
marks.note: the yellow rounded tile with the Miro glyph from the inline header logo of miro.com (wordmark cut out); style classes converted to fills from the site's own CSS: miro-yellow #FDE050, primary #1C1C1E. No brand kit or guidelines page is published (miro.com/brand, /about/brand, /press all 404; Miro's community says to ask).

marks.name: Mixpanel
marks.note: logo-mark-purple.svg from brand.mixpanel.com (Mixpanel Brand Guidelines, updated 2026-04-20), unchanged. Purple #7856FF is Mixpanel's signature colour and reads on white and on #1E1E1E; black and white logomarks (logo-mark.svg, logo-mark-white.svg) also exist.

marks.name: Mobbin
marks.note: mobbin.com has no brand or press page (/brand, /press return 404). The mark is the M in the site's own header (inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 139 64, fill currentColor, 'Mobbin' title); the path is unchanged and given fill #000 because currentColor is not available outside the page. The site's SVG favicon is a raster PNG inside an SVG, so the header M is the vector source. Mobbin's logo is this M.

marks.name: monday.com
marks.note: monday-logo.svg served by monday.com's own homepage (the logomark: red, yellow and green marks); dropped only the white <circle> backing. The press kit (monday.com/p/news/press-kit, logo pack 2026) ships PNG only; brand-monday.com refused every automated read (TLS handshake), so its rules are unread.

marks.name: n8n
marks.note: n8n_pink+black_logo.svg from n8n_logos.zip: kept only the first path (the pink #EA4B71 node-chain symbol), dropped the three wordmark paths and the clip group. Path unchanged; viewBox left at the logo's 576x160.

marks.name: Neon
marks.note: neon-logomark-light-color.svg unchanged. Green #37C38F is about 2:1 on white, and the kit has a mono logomark, so ink. Dark-ground colour variant differs by one shade of green only, so not shipped.

marks.name: Netlify
marks.note: Monogram kit: lightmode/logo-netlify-monogram-fullcolor-lightmode.svg and darkmode/logo-netlify-monogram-fullcolor-darkmode.svg, unchanged. Two-tone mark whose dark part turns white, so a dark file is shipped.

marks.name: New Relic
marks.note: Media-assets page, New-relic-emblem-green.svg (emblem without wordmark). Converted the .cls-1 class to fill=#46b978 attributes, removed XML header and defs. Kit also ships black and white emblems, so ink.

marks.name: Notion
marks.note: No downloadable kit reachable: notion.com/brand answers HTTP 401 to curl and WebFetch (app.notion.com/brand too). Taken from the inline SVG in the header of the live https://www.notion.com/ (class attribute and CSS variable removed; var(--notion-logo-fill) set to #000, its black value; two white paths are the cube's face as shipped). Not redrawn.

marks.name: Paddle
marks.note: Paddle's own app icon (the 310 px icon paddle.com links, PNG inside the SVG); Paddle publishes no kit, and its only vector is the wordmark, unreadable at a tile's size

marks.name: PayPal
marks.note: paypal-mark-color_new.svg, the monogram paypal.com serves from its own CDN; it matches the newsroom's PayPal-Monogram-FullColor PNG (the newsroom kit has no SVG), unchanged.

marks.name: PostHog
marks.note: posthog-logomark.svg (gradient hedgehog logomark) from brand.posthog.com, unchanged; dark = posthog-logomark-white.svg from the same kit. The brand site says the logomark alone is for small sizes such as favicons and app icons. The logomark has a #111 face part, so on dark use the white version, as the guidelines require.

marks.name: Postman
marks.note: Postman's own current logo icon (orange circle with white rocket details), as linked on the press page. Unchanged. Orange #ff6c37 is the primary logo and has contrast on both tiles.

marks.name: Qdrant
marks.note: qdrant-brandmark-red.svg (Logomark Full Color) from qdrant.tech/brand-resources; <style> classes converted to fill attributes (#9e0d38, #dc244c, #ff516b), ids removed, drawing unchanged. Black and white brandmarks also offered.

marks.name: Ramp
marks.note: Glyph cut out of logos/ramp-logo-black.svg in the Ramp media kit September 2026 (the kit has only the full wordmark-and-glyph lockup, no separate symbol): kept the glyph path byte-for-byte, dropped the wordmark path and clip, set the viewBox to the glyph. Black fill #0C0A08; kit also has a white lockup.

marks.name: Resend
marks.note: resend-icon-black.svg from the brand kit on resend.com/brand (resend-brand-assets.zip), unchanged. The kit also has resend-icon-white.svg (#FDFDFD), the version we had; black reads on white tiles, white on dark, and the page draws it in ink either way. Viewbox is 1800 with the R centred and padded; the generator measures the box.

marks.name: Runway
marks.note: Runway's own app icon (the apple-touch-icon runway.team links, 256 px PNG inside the SVG); its only vector is the 6:1 wordmark, unreadable at a tile's size

marks.name: Sanity
marks.note: Sanity has no brand page (/press, /brand 404). Took the inline SVG from sanity.io's current header (the scribble mark, matches the site's safari-pinned-tab.svg). Only change: fill=currentColor replaced by #000000 and the Tailwind class removed. One colour, so ink.

marks.name: Sentry
marks.note: Sentry glyph from the logo generator on sentry.io/branding (the page's own LogoGenerator script holds the glyph path, viewBox 0 0 50 44). Path copied unchanged into a standalone SVG with fill #181225 (the generator's dark colour). No separate kit file is linked; the Wordmark style was not used.

marks.name: Shortcut
